description: Source code for Service.cpp implementing classes and methods related to plugin services, request handling, file serving, and network configuration within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: PluginHost::Request
classes.description: Handles web requests, manages request state, and associates with a service object.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Provides service functionalities including notifications, file serving, and request identification.

classes.name: Plugin::Config
classes.description: Contains network configuration utilities, such as determining unicast IPv4 node addresses.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Request
methods.description: Constructor initializing request state and service reference.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request to an initial state, releasing the service if valid.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Set
methods.description: Sets the request state based on error code, service validity, and request type.

methods.name: IShell::Job::Create
methods.description: Creates a new job instance for the shell.

methods.name: Service::Notification
methods.description: Sends a message notification to all registered notifiers.

methods.name: Service::FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over web, handling MIME types and encoding, with fallback to index.html.

methods.name: Service::IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Checks if a URL segment matches the web server's prefix and path.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Determines the unicast IPv4 node address for a given network interface name or defaults to a public interface.
